prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Make an elegant 3:4 vertical museum exhibit poster from the source wardrobe photograph. Select only the visible pale blue floral lace garment section on its ivory hanger as the exhibit; preserve lace motif, pale blue color and natural folds. Show it as a textile fragment draped over a simple low ivory support, do not invent a complete dress or hem from this partial crop. Photoreal textile material in an original quiet warm-white display setting. Exhibit occupies about 55% canvas width, generous uninterrupted white space, no glass box needed. Bookish graceful Chinese serif. Exact text only: small series '私人生活博物馆'; medium title '还没出门'; two short label lines '浅蓝蕾丝与衣架' and '今天的选择，仍在等待。'. Tiny muted blue accent rule. No extra dates, brands, fiber composition claims, certification, codes or objects. Clear source identification, subtle directional soft light, delicate lace should remain visible and natural.

Use case: style-transfer. Repaint the source black dog reclining on a light sofa into an appealing 2D CARTOON PIXEL ART scene, one portrait 3:4 image, no text or UI. Keep the black floppy ears, long muzzle resting on the cushion, gently upward eyes, extended front paws and sofa/pillow arrangement. Retain a monochrome graphite/slate/ivory palette from the black-and-white source, bright soft sofa providing clear separation from the dark dog. Simplify body into deliberate 3–5 shade clusters, visible square steps and consistently sized pixels, around 240x320 visual drawing resolution enlarged cleanly. Expressive but recognizable natural dog proportions, airy cozy composition filling frame. No smooth photo textures, no individually drawn hairs, no noise dithering everywhere, no poster borders, no invented props, no captions or status bars.

Use case: style-transfer. Make one portrait 3:4 original pirate-anime WANTED poster from the source toy photo, select ONLY the large central tan teddy with black oval nose, rounded ears, light muzzle/feet and pale neck ribbon. Not the yellow bear carrying heart. Preserve those identifiers and seated pose, draw a lively ink manga portrait with warm tan flat shading and gentle comic expression. Large WANTED at top, framed portrait occupying half height, parchment cream and dark ink with controlled aged texture. Exact remaining text below: big Chinese alias '拥抱收藏家'; 'REWARD'; '66,000,000'; 'BERRIES'; small reason 'ACCEPTING HUGS. RETURNING NONE.'; footer 'FICTIONAL BOUNTY · FOR FUN'. Those are all the words. Amount correctly grouped, body text English only, no hats, weapons, insignia, existing manga characters, dense distress or other toys blended into face. Flat full-page poster, not a hanging mockup.

Use case: style-transfer. Reframe the supplied close-up clothes rail photograph as one quiet cinematic live-action still, true wide canvas approximately 2.39:1, no text and no black letterbox bars. Preserve chipped white wooden rail, silver hooks and ivory hangers, pale blue floral lace nearest middle-right, beige knitted garment behind, blush fabric in soft foreground right. Wide intimate lateral crop, rail leads across upper third, focus on single silver hook and blue lace shoulder; near right blush fabric soft blur, background falls gently out of focus. Natural window daylight softened by fabric, subtle muted rose/blue/ivory palette, restrained film grain and believable tonal depth. The feeling of a quiet morning before choosing what to wear, but no added person or invented room. Extend only the existing clothes/soft background as needed; preserve recognizable fabrics without geometric stretching. Not a catalog layout, poster, orange-teal night scene, miniature or illustration.

Use case: style-transfer. Rebuild the supplied breakfast as a premium tactile layered PAPER DIORAMA, portrait 3:4, no text. Preserve four golden croissants: one strawberry-filled on separate left foreground plate, three plain on right plate, strawberries, butter back left, glass of red drink back right, white cloth red stripe and fork front right. All subjects must be paper, even pastry: broad curled ochre paper bands for croissant folds, red inset strawberry paper shapes, folded ivory plates and draped scored paper cloth. Simplify texture into clear directional layers instead of thousands of flecks. The drink is suggested by layered translucent-looking colored paper planes, not real liquid. Source arrangement recognizable; slight raised thin base, soft side daylight creates thin cut edges and believable contact shadows. Warm amber, white, red, restrained pale blue. Open small stage with breathing room, not boxed, no title, labels, unrelated decorations, real photographic food, clay or shiny plastic.

Use case: style-transfer. Create one portrait 3:4 photograph of an open refined memory booklet on an ivory tabletop. Use the supplied group of old teddy bears as the only photo source. Right page large faithful printed photographic view retaining central tan teddy black oval nose/light muzzle/ribbon, yellow bear with red heart to right, surrounding smaller toys and checked fabric; do not merge their faces. Left page generous cream white space, medium elegant Chinese serif title EXACTLY '挤在一起的温柔', smaller English 'There is room for one more.' and one small detail crop of the central bear's paw and ribbon. Folios '05' and '06' only. Preserve source photo's natural texture, not cartoon. Open book covers about 85% canvas width, fine uncoated paper, gently bowed pages, believable center gutter and printed text following page plane. No fake second memory scene, no date/location or invented photo, no external toys, tape, flowers or props outside the book. Accurate all text and gentle editorial hierarchy.

Use case: style-transfer. Turn source worn sneakers into a witty precise technical illustration poster, portrait 3:4, warm ivory paper, black engraved linework and restrained ochre accent. Keep BOTH offwhite low sneakers, wide hook-and-loop straps, short grey laces, rounded dirty toe caps, yellowed soles and dark side shapes in the same offset arrangement, toes right. Do not turn shoes into pristine new shoes. Large Chinese title '出门设备使用说明', small 'MODEL WALK-01'. Central large fine-line illustration with clear shading and generous space around. Three noncrossing numbered leaders with exact labels: '01  INPUT: TWO FEET' to opening, '02  OUTPUT: SMALL ADVENTURES' to toe, '03  CONDITION: WELL USED' to worn sole. Bottom exact instruction 'Take the long way home.' and footer 'FICTIONAL MANUAL'. No other text or brand headline, no fake specs or extra icons. The marks on shoes remain secondary, typography must be legible, no tiny dense labels, no assembly exploded diagram.

Use case: style-transfer. Create one charming photo-derived FUSE BEAD mosaic keepsake, portrait 3:4 with spacious warm-white background and no text. Central small rectangular mosaic occupies 75% canvas width, photograph it almost straight overhead. Subject from supplied photo: charcoal tortoiseshell cat amber eyes tucked paws, laptop left with dark trees/orange lamp, ivory book lower right, orange mouse lower left. Simplify these into deliberate color regions in a neat regular grid of approximately 60 beads across visually, 12 restrained color families, each bead a uniform tiny short cylinder with round center hole and subtly softened square-round perimeter. Entire illustration built by bead colors, no smooth photograph printed on top. Golden eyes and orange accents identifiable at this scale. Real tactile mild plastic sheen, tiny individual shadows and holes, one tidy pale bead outline, thickness visible at lower edge, subtle shadow onto blank paper. No loose beads, work tools, type, extraneous decor, Lego studs, embroidery or continuous photographic fur. A sophisticated collectible souvenir, not a precise construction chart.

Use case: style-transfer. Translate source park bench into a tactile FUSE BEAD mosaic keepsake centered on natural white blank paper, one portrait 3:4 composition with comfortable margins, no text. Mosaic 75% of canvas width. Preserve large charcoal curved-rib bench on right, pale ochre path opening left and layered green park background. Make a clean intentional color-block reduction, around 60 beads across visual scale with 10–14 charcoal/moss/sage/cream/ochre color families. EVERY bead equally sized with unmistakable tiny center hole, short cylindrical plastic body, regular rows and columns, mild fused edges and a neat pale single-bead border. All shading inside mosaic determined by bead colors; avoid a photograph underneath a dot texture. Near overhead view, consistent material lighting and gentle cast shadow below small rectangle. Strong recognizable bench silhouette and path negative space. No loose beads, tools, typography, Lego, knitting, background photo, giant pegboard or spurious buildings. Image is a decorative bead-art mockup, not a guaranteed craft plan.

Use case: style-transfer. Design an outstanding original one-ink editorial poster from source black dog lying on light sofa. Portrait 3:4, natural ivory paper with cobalt blue as ONLY printing ink, visible organized halftone dots and restrained dry ink. Dramatically enlarge the long dog muzzle, floppy ear and upward eye as source-identifiable hero, cropping lower left/center with face occupying lower two thirds, never losing eyes and nose. Big very condensed bold sans-serif typography top left EXACTLY 'OFF' then 'DUTY.' on separate lines, oversized but fully legible, with lots of untouched upper right negative space. Tiny sole secondary caption upper right 'Rest is the whole plan.' No other text or leader lines required. Main photo is translated into blue halftone values, expressive dots carry form, clean high contrast and subtle paper grain. No added treat, collar, people, secondary object, extra colors, borders, vintage grime or newspaper columns. Precise modern composition, quiet humorous attitude.

Use case: style-transfer. Create an original bold TWO-INK editorial food poster from source breakfast photo, portrait 3:4, cream paper ground, cobalt blue main ink and rust-red second ink ONLY. Pick source strawberry-filled croissant on left plate as huge cropped hero across bottom two thirds. Keep its curved flaky shape, visible strawberry slices and cream filling recognizable. Render pastry, plate edges and shadows as rich cobalt halftone texture; use rust red ONLY for real source strawberry slices, not invented props. Very large condensed bold sans-serif type on upper left in blue: 'SLOW' then 'MORNING.'; preserve every letter within margins. One tiny secondary caption at upper right exactly 'Leave a little room.' No other words, borders, badges, dense annotations or little graphic motifs. Upper right mostly open cream paper, hero crop bold yet identifiable. Dots follow tones like a beautiful spot-ink print, no glossy photo colors, watercolor or random grain overlay.

Use case: style-transfer. Make a quiet photo-and-miniature-illustration diptych poster from source bench, one portrait 3:4 image, no text. TOP HALF is a natural photographic panel preserving the exact distinctive dark curved ribs and seat slats of the park bench, near end at right, pale path receding left, blurred green foliage. Fit source safely without stretching; source identification and camera relationship matter more than keeping every background pixel. BOTTOM HALF natural warm-white paper with generous untouched space. At center of lower half a very small original dry-brush hand-painted vignette, about 45% of panel width and 30% height (roughly 14% panel area): same curved bench right and only a faint ochre path mark leading left plus one restrained green foliage suggestion. Maximum four main color families charcoal/olive/ochre/paper. Delicate irregular contour, flat gouache/acrylic-like color shapes, dry brush and subtle paper fibers. Truly distilled miniature, not a shrunk copy of photo, not photoreal or dense detailed landscape. Equal half-height split, unified restrained palette, no captions, invented scenery, frame, collage, shadowbox, stickers or decorations.

Use case: style-transfer. Produce one beautiful restrained 3:4 vertical photography-and-small-hand-painted-illustration diptych, no text. Top half: source-faithful natural photographic view of charcoal tortoiseshell cat with golden round eyes and tucked paws, left laptop with orange lamp/tree screen, right open book and orange mouse foreground. Preserve cat face and central spatial relations, safe fit without stretching; natural photographic textures and subdued grading. Bottom half: uninterrupted warm offwhite fine fiber paper, with ONE tiny centered source-derived hand-painted vignette occupying only around 12–16% of bottom panel area. Distill cat into a few expressive charcoal/umber shapes, two tiny amber eyes, two subtle ivory book planes and minimal laptop edge suggesting the same scene. Fine slightly irregular hand contour plus sparing dry acrylic brush edges, at most four main pigment families. Great amount of breathing room around miniature. Not a detailed full scene, watercolor wash, cartoon character, pixel art, paper sculpture or photograph thumbnail. Upper/lower panels each half height, calm meaningful visual echo, no title, signature, logo, mockup or extraneous invented props.
